statement: When a validation record gains another established state, classify established states by explicit set membership: require a measurement and forbid stale missing-evidence fields. A claim of pinned evidence must resolve a full commit SHA, read the named blob from that commit, and verify its digest. Include a valid control and independent mutations for absent pins, changed digests, changed paths, and contradictory pending fields; a validator that only rejects records does not establish a usable success path. Git batch object lookup can report an object as missing and exit zero while stderr reports corrupt object data; retain those diagnostics as unresolved rather than claiming absence. A committed-blob pin also needs a divergence control that passes while working-tree bytes differ, and fails only under a deliberate working-tree-read substitution.
